description: This file implements hardware-accelerated CRC32 checksum computations optimized for Intel and ARM architectures, including classes and functions for different CPU types and SIMD instruction usage.

classes.name: CRC32AcceleratedX86ARMCombined
classes.description: Implements hardware-accelerated CRC32 checksum calculations for x86 and ARM architectures, with methods for extending CRCs and computing zero extension constants.

classes.name: CRC32AcceleratedX86ARMCombinedMultipleStreams
classes.description: Template class for processing multiple CRC streams in parallel, optimized for different CPU capabilities and data sizes.

classes.name: CRC32AcceleratedX86ARMCombinedMultipleStreamsBase
classes.description: Base class providing shared methods and constants for multi-stream CRC processing.

methods.name: ExtendByZeroes
methods.description: Extends the CRC value by a specified number of zero bytes efficiently.

methods.name: ComputeZeroConstant
methods.description: Calculates a constant used to extend CRCs by zeros via multiplication.

methods.name: Process64BytesCRC
methods.description: Processes 64 bytes of data to update the CRC value.

methods.name: TryNewCRC32AcceleratedX86ARMCombined
methods.description: Detects CPU type and returns an appropriate hardware-accelerated CRC implementation if available.

methods.name: NewCRC32AcceleratedX86ARMCombinedAll
methods.description: Creates a collection of all available hardware-accelerated CRC implementations.
